tagline: Making a difference, every person, every day.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of ABM's size and scope of operations in the facility services maintenance sector. It reflects overall growth and the company's ability to deliver solutions to its customers, with revenue exceeding $8.5 billion.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue exceeding $8.5 billion demonstrates ABM's growth, primarily through strategic acquisitions and new service offerings.
kpis.signal: Significant growth driven by strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by normal business operations.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow is a strong indicator of financial performance and ability to fund growth. The increase of $7.7 million in 2025 reflects effective working capital management.
kpis.signal: Increased cash flow from working capital management.

kpis.name: Available Borrowing Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total amount the company can borrow under its credit facilities.
kpis.description: Available borrowing capacity indicates the company's financial flexibility to meet liquidity needs. The revolving credit facility ceiling was increased to $1.6 billion under the amended agreement of February 26, 2025.
kpis.signal: Strong borrowing capacity to support operations and growth.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the past four years.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the past four years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past four years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past four years.

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past four years.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Total amount of shares repurchased by the company.
kpis.description: Increased share repurchases indicate management confidence in the company's value and commitment to return capital to shareholders. The program was expanded by $150 million on September 3, 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in share repurchases, enhanced shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Contingent Consideration Payments
kpis.explanation: Payments made following prior acquisitions, based on future performance.
kpis.description: Contingent consideration payments are tied to post-acquisition performance, reflecting financial commitments related to past transactions. The RavenVolt payment of $75 million in 2025 includes $16 million in operating cash flow and $59 million in financing cash flow.
kpis.signal: Significant payment related to RavenVolt acquisition, impacting cash flows.

risks.title: Cyber threats that could materially harm operations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is identified early in Item 1A with strong language indicating material risk of negative impact. The company acknowledges uncertainty regarding insurance coverage for all losses. The risk is central to governance with monitoring by the CISO, management, and Board, underscoring its strategic importance.

ai_positioning.summary: ABM Industries integrates artificial intelligence within its governance framework. The Board of Directors oversees risks related to AI technologies and cybersecurity, indicating awareness of the growing strategic importance of AI.
evidence: Board oversight of AI risks mentioned in Item 1A Risk Factors
Chief Information Security Officer and Chief Information Officer responsible for assessing and managing AI-related risks
AI governance integrated into cybersecurity risk management framework
Process for assessing, identifying, managing, and mitigating material risks from AI-related threats
